text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Heavy rain had been pouring non-stop since 
morning. Amidst the occasional rumble of 
thunder, TM Opera O was—shouting.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, heavens! Bear this in mind! No 
tempest shall ever bring me to my knees!"

text_block_list.name: Braided Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... It's okay, Ope-chan. With 
pouring rain like this, it's impossible...

text_block_list.name: Twintail Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...We have to let the audience know it's 
canceled, don't we? After all that 
practice... it's a real shame."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Don't give up, everyone!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's still time! Please... believe in 
me!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Umm... The truth is, well...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We were actually planning to put on a play 
using the outdoor stage today...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... it's part of our volunteer 
activities. ...Though with this 
downpour... there's not much we can do...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No, the heavens are simply trying to test 
my resolve...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueh!? O-Opera O-san!? Where on earth are 
you—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear me, O sky! O heavens! O 
thunder! Even if you try to drown out my 
voice!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after T.M. Opera O who suddenly 
bolted, it seemed she was heading for the 
rooftop. I scrambled up the stairs right 
after herâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Shaaaaaah!! Krrr-crash!!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I shall give people dreams! Struck by 
rain, confronting the wind, as I sprint 
through the roaring thunder...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
This will cannot be shaken!! Because!! I 
am... I am the one true champion!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
For I am T.M. Opera O... the one who will 
become the "End-of-Century Overlord"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O shouted toward the sky, pelted 
by the pouring rain. Seeing that sightâ

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O shouted toward the sky, pelted 
by the pouring rain. Seeing that sightâ

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought TM Opera O inside and had her 
change her clothes immediately.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... And to think, I haven't even 
conveyed the full depth of my feelings 
yet."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But if you stay like that, you're going 
to catch a cold...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-Opera O-san, look outside! Please, look 
outside!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hah... Wh-What is this!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: The rain... has stopped!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
With this, it looks like it will clear up 
nicely by the afternoon...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! You have finally acknowledged 
me, haven't you, heavens?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There may be times ahead where you rebel 
against me again. However, I am T.M. Opera 
O!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times you rebel against 
me, my will shall never be broken!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, by the afternoon, the rain clouds 
had completely dispersed, and the dazzling 
sun showed its face.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a stage encircled by water-glistening 
trees, TM Opera O shone more brilliantly 
than ever, and the curtain fell amidst 
thunderous cheers.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And after shouting toward the heavens for 
a while, I brought T.M. Opera O inside and 
had her change clothes right away.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Going out in the rain like that... You're 
going to catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... To convey my feelings to such a 
mischievous sky, this much is absolutely 
necessary.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Besides... just look at the sky!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh!? H-Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: No way... The rain stopped...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahahaha! This is the sheer power of my 
will!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even the sun itself cannot help but yearn 
for my brilliance!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Feel free to worship me! For I am T.M. 
Ope—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Achoooo!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-wawawa! I-I'll go get some medicine~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, by the afternoon, the rain clouds 
had completely cleared, and the brilliant 
sun peeked through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O was in peak condition... no, 
she shone brighter than ever, and the 
stage for the day ended without a hitch.
